H1: Reported political views will have an influence on a composite jealousy in relationships variable (jealousy about emotional infidelity, jealousy about sexual infidelity).
  IV: Political views
  DV: Jealousy in relationships composite score

H2: Reported financial prospects will have an influence on preferred long-term partner age.
  IV: Financial prospects
  DV: Preferred long-term partner age
  
```{r load package + data}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("ggrain")


h1 <- read.csv("data/processed/h1.csv")
h2 <- read.csv("data/processed/h2.csv")

```
  
```{r h1 plot}
h1Plot <- ggplot(data = h1,
                 aes(x = politics,
                     y = jealousy))+
    labs(x = "Political Views",
       y = "Jealousy",
       title = "Jealousy in Romantic Relationships by Political Views")+
  geom_rain(likert=T)+
   theme_gray(base_size = 8)

h1Plot
```

```{r h2 plot}

h2Plot <- ggplot(data = h2,
                 aes(x = financialProspects,
                     y = freeTime)) +
  labs(x = "Financial Prospects",
       y = "Daily Free Time (Minutes)",
       title = "Daily Free Time by Individual Financial Prospects") +
  geom_jitter(width = .12, height = 0, alpha = .10, size = .6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")


h2Plot
```


```{r saving figures}

ggsave("Figures/h1_figure.png", plot = h1Plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave("Figures/h2_figure.png", plot = h2Plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
